name: 23909-visionarena-internvl2-1b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP off; one in-process engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, no arrival rate, bounded at 1000 requests / 900 s, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: `lmarena-ai/VisionArena-Chat`, hf split `train`, as a prepared local 1000-row copy (built below): one picture and one user turn per request, 128-token answer budget with EOS honoured (`ignore_eos: false`), `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A compact vision chat assistant answering single-image questions with short replies for 64 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.10.2rc2-era engine args: an unknown key is an error at engine construction.
model: OpenGVLab/InternVL2-1B
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 2
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
